resolution.method: EAS exact match on 801 MARKET ST → parcel 3705Z001; sf-parcels has blklot 3705Z001 active, 801–815 MARKET; the 2025 roll records it as commercial hotel, built 1999. The assessor files the parcel as 12 04TH ST. EAS puts 801, 815 MARKET ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 801. 801 MARKET ST's coordinates fall in 4 active parcels; 3705Z001 is the one with a page.
